speaker: HASLUSH
description: Haslush Ikzeteri is a middle-aged male detective with a gruff, low-pitched timbre and a detective-noir cadence. His default delivery is calm, measured, and casually relaxed — often bordering on a lazy façade — but can sharpen suddenly when probing or annoyed, marked by a distinctive tongue-clack tic. He speaks in short, blunt sentences with dry humor and occasional colorful curses, conveying world-weary skepticism tempered by pragmatic openness to the extraordinary. Direction: keep the tone conversational yet sharp, allowing a relaxed drawl to snap into focused intensity without losing his professional, non-stiff composure.
ref_text: Why all this cloak and dagger stuff, if I may ask? Well, I'll be damned. That's not a piece of magic you see every day.
